summary: Join our specialized training course for administrators and secretaries. Build core skills that empower you to excel in your administrative role.
lede: Administrative training helps executive assistants, secretaries and office administrators coordinate schedules, information and office workflows. It builds practical skills in prioritizing requests, managing Outlook calendars, preparing meeting materials and tracking actions, alongside consistent records handling, secure collaboration and concise workload reporting using tools such as Excel, Word, Teams and SharePoint.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate information, schedules, communications, meetings, and executive support in demanding office environments. It suits intermediate to advanced practitioners who want to standardize their administrator skills, strengthen judgment, and produce more reliable work without relying on informal personal systems.
prerequisites: You should have at least six months of experience in administrative support, secretarial work, executive assistance, office coordination, or a related role. Familiarity with email, calendars, word processing, spreadsheets, and workplace file storage is expected. No programming is required. You will use automation examples at an operational application level rather than build production software. Bring anonymized examples of a calendar challenge, meeting workflow, tracker, or document process if available; do not bring confidential organizational information.
